# Plainwork

> Plainwork is a studio in London, United Kingdom, opened in November 2026 and run by Fanze Meng. It checks whether AI assistants such as ChatGPT can read a small business website, fixes what stops them, and builds websites for small businesses in any trade, online shops included. The work is done by AI agents (Claude and other models) that Fanze Meng operates. An AI agent also reads and answers the enquiry email. Fanze Meng is the person responsible for the contract and the payment.

Website: https://fanzemeng31-arch.github.io/plainwork/
Chinese version: https://fanzemeng31-arch.github.io/plainwork/zh.html
Contact: fanzemeng31+plainwork@gmail.com (email only)

## Free check

Email a website address to the contact address. A program checks the homepage on 13 points, and the results come back by email within one working day, free of charge. The program is open source: https://github.com/fanzemeng31-arch/plainwork/blob/main/tools/geocheck.py

## Services and prices (GBP, fixed quote before any work starts)

- GEO audit, £90. GEO means generative engine optimisation: making it more likely that AI assistants describe a business correctly and recommend it. A written report in 3 days. It runs the 13-point check on up to 10 pages, records what several AI models say when asked the questions customers would ask (the models are asked without live web search), and lists the changes to make in order of importance.
- GEO fixes, from £350. The changes from the audit are made on the site. No promise is made about what any AI assistant will say afterwards.
- Website: one page from £180; up to five pages from £450; a product catalogue or shop front of up to 30 products from £700. For a small business in any trade. Static files, works on phones, the client owns the code. Delivery 3 to 7 days.
- Small AI applications, from £400: a question-answering app over the client's own documents, a small web app, or a WeChat mini-program. Delivery 1 to 2 weeks.
- Figures for research papers: £30 for one figure with up to 2 panels, £60 for one figure with up to 6 panels. The client emails a data file (CSV or Excel), the question the figure must answer, and the journal or the width. Delivered: vector PDF, SVG, 300 dpi PNG, the Python script that draws the figure, a statistics note and a draft caption. Terms for figures differ from the other services: a small preview image comes back within two working days free of charge, the client pays the full price through a Stripe payment link only if they want the files, and one round of changes is included. Data are never invented, changed or left out. Photographs, gels, blots and microscope images are not edited; drawn illustrations and figures that need R packages are not offered. The data file is read by AI models through other companies' API services and is deleted 30 days after delivery; data that identifies a person must not be sent. Details and samples: https://fanzemeng31-arch.github.io/plainwork/figures.html

## How it works

Email your website address for the free check, or say what you need. A fixed quote comes back within one working day. Half is paid before work starts and half on delivery, by card through a Stripe payment link. One round of changes is included. If the first delivery is not what was agreed and the changes do not fix it, the deposit is returned.

## What the check program found on 40 manufacturer websites

Run on 2026-11-23 on the homepages of 20 manufacturers in the United Kingdom and 20 in China. No working HTTPS: UK 0 of 20, China 5 of 20. No meta description: UK 1 of 20, China 9 of 18. No JSON-LD structured data: UK 4 of 20, China 14 of 18. No sitemap: UK 3 of 20, China 9 of 18. At least one main AI crawler disallowed in robots.txt: 1 of 38. The sample is small, was not drawn at random and covers manufacturers only. Report: https://fanzemeng31-arch.github.io/plainwork/geo-benchmark.html

## Work shown

The studio is new and shows its own work: the check program, the benchmark above, and Reference Audit, a browser tool that checks a reference list against open scholarly indexes (https://fanzemeng31-arch.github.io/reference-audit/). Client work will be added as it is delivered and with the client's permission.

## Not claimed

No team, no past clients, no testimonials, no awards and no project counts are claimed. Nobody can control what an AI assistant says.
